title: Marchbank退休工资合规评估
instruction:
您是 Marchbank Instruments 的证券和金融服务销售代理，为合规性提供支持。托马斯·菲茨杰拉德 (Tomas Fitzgerald) 要求您在 10 月份拉什米尔理事会 (Rushmere Council) 会议之前准备一份干净的版本，此前一名审查员观察了 8 月份的“退休薪水”图书馆研讨会。该套牌仍被保留，但阿内塔·艾尔巴兹 (Aneta Elbaz) 和艾格尼丝·桑多瓦尔 (Agnes Sandoval) 在九项赛事中使用的口头脚本和邮寄邀请函已被标记。措辞需要修改，而不是新的销售演示：脚本包括“保证月收入”，将计划咨询称为“免费计划审查”，并显示标有“典型结果”的图表；该邀请函并未明确指出 Marchbank Instruments 是一家经纪自营商。在工作目录的顶层创建`retirement_paycheck_compliance_assessment.docx`。它应该包含一个带注释的脚本和一个重写的邀请函，以便广大非专业受众能够理解。显示确切的有问题的行或段落，确定截至 9 月30、2025 有效的适用美国证券通信标准，明确解释为什么该措辞不可接受，并提供 Deshan Kirrane 自然可以大声说出或可以邮寄的替代语言，而不会听起来像法律免责声明。
保持研讨会的目的和普通观众的基调，但在不确定性、风险、假设以及普通教育和个性化建议之间的差异方面，修改后的措辞要准确。对于没有参加过研讨会的人来说，邀请函必须是独立的。不要发明简报中未提及的绩效数据、客户成果、保证、认可、证书或产品条款。包括针对异常情况的简短处理说明，其中与会者表示他们立即需要保证收入金额或在公开会议期间要求个人推荐；该案十分严重，不宜用一般措辞掩盖。还要解决导致审查的常规滥用问题：初级代表一直在使用“免费计划审查”来吸引人们进行一对一的销售对话。将完整的文档控制在四页或更少，使用清晰的标题和可追踪的行引用，并以批准的措辞而不是未来任务的列表结束。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `retirement_paycheck_compliance_assessment.docx` — 对退休薪水研讨会脚本的带注释评估，以及重写的邀请和实际处理指南。 （准确使用此文件名写入求解器起始工作目录的顶层。文档必须为四页或更少，可供广大非专业受众阅读，并且必须包括带注释的脚本和邀请重写。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
RETIREMENT PAYCHECK
Communications Compliance Assessment and Approved Public Wording
SCOPE
Rushmere Council library seminar and mailed invitation; retained deck is not revised.
JURISDICTION / DATE
United States
As of September 30, 2025
USE
Approval aid for Deshan Kirrane and junior representatives.
ASSESSMENT STANDARD
This assessment applies the U.S. broker-dealer communications principles in FINRA Rule 2210. Rule 2210(d)(1)(A) requires a fair and balanced presentation of risks and benefits; Rule 2210(d)(1)(B) bars false, misleading, promissory, exaggerated, or unwarranted statements; and Rule 2210(d)(1)(F) restricts predictions or projections of investment performance. Apply the rule to the overall impression, not just isolated words.
Annotated Script: Findings and Approved Replacements
REF.
SOURCE PASSAGE
WHY THIS CANNOT BE USED / STANDARD
APPROVED SPOKEN WORDING
S-01
“guaranteed monthly income”
FINRA Rule 2210(d)(1)(B). “Guaranteed” promises an income outcome without a stated, legally and factually supportable basis. It hides assumptions, market changes, product terms, and personal circumstances that can affect income.
“Today we will discuss ways people think about turning savings into retirement income. What an income plan can provide depends on your savings, choices, product terms, market conditions, and your own situation. Income can fall short, and investments can lose value.”
S-02
“complimentary plan review”
FINRA Rule 2210(d)(1)(A)-(B). It can sound like a free, objective planning service when used to invite a one-to-one sales conversation. That is a misleading commercial context and blurs general education with individualized advice.
“After the program, you may ask for a no-charge educational conversation with a Marchbank representative. It may include a discussion of our services or products. It is not a personal recommendation or a complete review of your plan.”
S-03
Chart label: “typical results”
FINRA Rule 2210(d)(1)(A), (B), and (F). “Typical” is a performance claim. It is unsupported here: no defined population, period, method, assumptions, or substantiation is provided. It may imply that an illustration or past experience predicts an attendee’s outcome.
“Do not show the chart with this label. If the chart remains in the retained deck, say: ‘This is only an illustration of questions people may consider. It is not a forecast or a promise of results, and it does not show what you will receive.’ Do not describe any result as typical.”
Invitation Finding and Approved Replacement
REF.
SOURCE PASSAGE
WHY THIS CANNOT BE USED / STANDARD
APPROVED TREATMENT
I-01
Invitation omission: Marchbank Instruments is not identified as a broker-dealer.
FINRA Rule 2210(d)(1)(A)-(B). Leaving the firm’s regulated sales capacity implicit can give a reader a misleading picture of who is offering the event and the commercial context. The invitation must disclose that Marchbank Instruments is a broker-dealer in plain language.
Use the self-contained approved invitation below. Identify the firm prominently as a broker-dealer and explain the session is educational, not individualized investment advice.
Representative Use: Routine and Exceptional Situations
Routine control: Do not use “complimentary plan review,” or a substitute that suggests a free personal plan review, to obtain one-to-one sales meetings. Offer only the approved “no-charge educational conversation” wording. Before any private discussion moves to recommendations, follow firm supervision and the applicable customer-information and suitability / Regulation Best Interest process.
Exceptional case - urgent guaranteed amount or personal recommendation: Say, “I hear that this feels urgent. I cannot tell you today what amount can be guaranteed or recommend a personal investment in this public session. We can arrange a private follow-up through Marchbank so the right information and options can be considered.” Do not calculate a promised income amount, select a product, or take recommendation instructions at the seminar.
Approved Mailed Invitation
The wording below is the approved outward-facing copy. Use it as written; it stands on its own.
RETIREMENT PAYCHECK: A PUBLIC LIBRARY PROGRAM
Rushmere Council library  |  October dates
Join Marchbank Instruments, a broker-dealer, for a general educational discussion about retirement income. We will talk about questions people consider when planning how savings may support spending in retirement.
The program is for general information. It is not individualized investment advice, a recommendation, or a review of your personal plan. Retirement income can depend on savings, spending, market conditions, product terms, and personal circumstances. Investments involve risk, including possible loss, and an income plan may not provide enough income for every need.
After the program, you may request a no-charge educational conversation with a Marchbank representative. The conversation may include discussion of Marchbank services or products. Any personal recommendation, if appropriate, would require a separate private conversation and information about your circumstances.
Presented by Marchbank Instruments, broker-dealer. Please contact Rushmere Council library for program details.

criteria.description: 提交的文件是一个可读的 DOCX，名为 retirement_paycheck_compliance_assessment.docx。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件及其文件内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的文件名、扩展名，以及文档是否打开并以清晰的文本呈现。

original.criterion: The submitted file is a readable DOCX named retirement_paycheck_compliance_assessment.docx.
original.evidence: The submitted file and its document contents.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact filename, extension, and that the document opens and renders with legible text.

criteria.description: 当使用普通的办公分页呈现时，完整的文档不超过四页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准无头办公转换器或同等工具渲染 DOCX 并计算页面数；不要仅仅为了满足上限而奖励微小的或不可用的文本。

original.criterion: The complete document is no more than four pages when rendered with ordinary office pagination.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard headless office converter or equivalent and count pages; do not reward microscopic or unusable text merely to meet the cap.

criteria.description: 评估引用或以其他方式重现了四个来源问题中的每一个：“保证月收入”、“免费计划审查”、图表标签“典型结果”以及邀请函未能将公司标识为经纪自营商。
criteria.evidence: 带注释的脚本和邀请评估。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个问题是否可追溯到相应的来源措辞或遗漏，而不是仅在一般性结论中提及。

original.criterion: The assessment quotes or otherwise reproduces each of the four source problems: “guaranteed monthly income,” “complimentary plan review,” the chart label “typical results,” and the invitation's failure to identify the firm as a broker-dealer.
original.grader_hint: Check that each issue is traceable to the corresponding source wording or omission, rather than being mentioned only in a general conclusion.

criteria.description: 每个标记的行或段落都有一个独特的可追踪标识符、引用或位置参考，链接问题、标准、基本原理和替换措辞。
criteria.evidence: 与源段落相邻或交叉引用的注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 审阅者应该能够从引用的行转到其发现和批准的替换行，而无需猜测正在更正哪个文本。

original.criterion: Every flagged line or passage has a distinct traceable identifier, quotation, or location reference that links the issue, standard, rationale, and replacement wording.
original.evidence: Annotations adjacent to or cross-referenced with the source passages.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to move from a quoted line to its finding and approved replacement without guessing which text is being corrected.

criteria.description: 该评估将担保索赔与具体适用的美国证券通信规则或标准挂钩，并解释说，如果没有法律和事实支持的基础，就不能将结果或收入流呈现为有担保的。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受准确适用的 FINRA 或 SEC 权威和合理的解释；拒绝模糊的提及，例如仅仅说“合规规则”。

original.criterion: The assessment anchors the guarantee claim to a specific applicable U.S. securities-communications rule or standard and explains that an outcome or income stream cannot be presented as guaranteed without a legally and factually supportable basis.
original.evidence: The finding for the guaranteed-income passage.
original.grader_hint: Accept a precise applicable FINRA or SEC authority and a sound explanation; reject vague references such as merely saying 'compliance rules.'

criteria.description: 担保索赔的替代使用有条件的、非承诺性的语言，并传达退休收入取决于相关假设、市场、产品或个人情况的信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 替代者必须取消保证，而不仅仅是添加一个象征性的“可能”，同时保留客观承诺的结果。

original.criterion: The replacement for the guarantee claim uses conditional, non-promissory language and communicates that retirement income depends on relevant assumptions, markets, products, or personal circumstances.
original.grader_hint: The replacement must remove the guarantee, not just add a token 'may' while retaining an objectively promised result.

criteria.description: 该评估确定了为什么“免费计划审查”可能会在互动的性质、成本、目的或销售背景方面误导公众受众，并将调查结果与特定的沟通或广告标准联系起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找商业背景和个性化建议问题，而不仅仅是对不同措辞的偏好。

original.criterion: The assessment identifies why “complimentary plan review” can mislead a public audience about the nature, cost, purpose, or sales context of the interaction and ties the finding to a specific communications or advertising standard.
original.grader_hint: Look for the commercial-context and individualized-advice issue, not merely a preference for different wording.

criteria.description: 替换邀请和脚本将会议描述为一般教育信息，并在不掩饰该目的的情况下披露了业务或销售对话的可能性。
criteria.evidence: 审查邀请和研讨会脚本的替换措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果实际互动可能导致招揽或产品讨论，则该语言不应暗示免费的信托规划服务。

original.criterion: The replacement invitation and script describe the meeting as general educational information and disclose the possibility of a business or sales conversation without disguising that purpose.
original.evidence: Replacement wording for the review invitation and seminar script.
original.grader_hint: The language should not imply a free fiduciary planning service if the actual interaction may lead to solicitation or product discussion.

criteria.description: 该评估将“典型结果”视为潜在误导性的绩效表述，并确定在使用典型结果声明之前需要确定的人群、时期、方法和证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于具有必要背景的可辩护合规重新标签或删除不受支持的图表声明；不需要发明的数字数据。

original.criterion: The assessment treats “typical results” as a potentially misleading performance presentation and identifies the need for a defined population, period, methodology, and substantiation before using a typical-results claim.
original.grader_hint: Credit either a defensible compliant relabelling with the necessary context or removal of the unsupported chart claim; do not require invented numerical data.

criteria.description: 图表的替代处理不会发明绩效数据，也不会暗示说明、历史结果或假设示例可以预测与会者的结果。
criteria.evidence: 修改了图表处理或脚本语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否存在明显的不确定性以及是否存在捏造的数字、成功率或客户结果。

original.criterion: The replacement treatment for the chart does not invent performance figures or imply that an illustration, historical result, or hypothetical example predicts an attendee's result.
original.evidence: Revised chart treatment or script language.
original.grader_hint: Check for explicit uncertainty and the absence of fabricated numbers, success rates, or client outcomes.

criteria.description: 重写后的邀请函以一种突出、简单的语言方式将 Marchbank Instruments 标识为经纪交易商，而不是隐含该公司的监管能力。
criteria.grader_hint: 该披露必须出现在邀请函本身中，并且对于非专业人士来说是可以理解的；隐藏的、无法解释的缩写词是不够的。

original.criterion: The rewritten invitation identifies Marchbank Instruments as a broker-dealer in a prominent, plain-language manner rather than leaving the firm's regulated capacity implicit.
original.grader_hint: The disclosure must appear in the invitation itself and be understandable to a non-specialist; a buried unexplained acronym is insufficient.

criteria.description: 邀请函和脚本将一般教育内容与个性化投资建议区分开来，并避免暗示仅出席即可产生推荐、适合性确定或客户关系。
criteria.evidence: 公开会议披露和邀请副本。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个有意义的边界，而不是一个与根据研讨会内容采取行动的呼吁相矛盾的孤立的通用免责声明。

original.criterion: The invitation and script distinguish general educational content from individualized investment advice and avoid suggesting that attendance alone creates a recommendation, suitability determination, or client relationship.
original.grader_hint: Look for a meaningful boundary, not an isolated generic disclaimer contradicted by calls to act on the seminar content.

criteria.description: 修订后的面向公众的语言以平衡的方式呈现了重大投资和退休收入风险或不确定性，包括仍然可能出现损失或收入不足。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件不必成为产品说明书，但也不能保留单方面只顾利益的信息。

original.criterion: The revised public-facing language presents material investment and retirement-income risks or uncertainties in balanced terms, including that losses or insufficient income remain possible.
original.grader_hint: The document need not become a product prospectus, but it must not retain a one-sided benefit-only message.

criteria.description: 四项调查结果中的每一项都指定了一个可识别的适用标准或规则，并将该标准与特定缺陷联系起来，而不是列出未经应用的权威机构。
criteria.grader_hint: 自规定日期起接受精心挑选的 FINRA、SEC 或直接适用的经纪交易商通信标准；评估解释，而不是强制的引用格式。

original.criterion: Each of the four findings names a recognizable applicable standard or rule and connects that standard to the particular defect, rather than listing authorities without application.
original.evidence: The standards column or equivalent annotations.
original.grader_hint: Accept well-chosen FINRA, SEC, or directly applicable broker-dealer communications standards as of the stated date; assess the explanation, not a mandated citation format.

criteria.description: 该文件规定了美国管辖权以及用于合规评估的截止日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认管辖权和日期均明确且与请求一致。

original.criterion: The document states the governing U.S. jurisdiction and the as-of date used for its compliance assessment.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that both jurisdiction and date are explicit and consistent with the request.

criteria.description: 对于与会者在公开会议期间紧急要求保证收入金额或要求个人推荐的特殊情况，与普通研讨会指导分开处理，与现场提出个性化推荐有明确的界限。
criteria.grader_hint: 该说明应为与会者提供可用的语言和安全的处置，而不承诺结果或进行不适当的公开会议评估。

original.criterion: The exceptional case involving an attendee who urgently demands a guaranteed income amount or asks for a personal recommendation during the public session is handled separately from ordinary seminar guidance, with a clear boundary against making an on-the-spot individualized recommendation.
original.grader_hint: The note should provide usable language and a safe disposition for the attendee without promising an outcome or conducting an unsuitable public-session assessment.

criteria.description: 该文件积极劝阻初级代表不要使用“免费计划审查”的短语或概念作为未公开的一对一销售对话的潜在客户开发工具。
criteria.evidence: 代表使用指南和批准的邀请措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于明确的禁止或替代做法，以解决反复出现的滥用问题；仅仅解释原来的短语含糊不清是不够的。

original.criterion: The document actively discourages junior representatives from using the phrase or concept of a 'complimentary plan review' as a lead-generation device for an undisclosed one-to-one sales conversation.
original.evidence: Representative-use guidance and approved invitation wording.
original.grader_hint: Credit an explicit prohibition or replacement practice that addresses the recurring misuse; merely explaining that the original phrase is ambiguous is not enough.

criteria.description: 替换语言听起来像是初级代表可以向普通图书馆与会者大声说出的话，同时保持准确和适当的资格。
criteria.evidence: 完整修改的剧本和邀请。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断对话的清晰度、简洁性和自然的节奏。对密集的法律样板、无法解释的行话或代表无法实际表达的措辞进行处罚。

original.criterion: The replacement language sounds like something a junior representative could say aloud to ordinary library attendees, while remaining accurate and appropriately qualified.
original.grader_hint: Judge for conversational clarity, brevity, and natural cadence. Penalize dense legal boilerplate, unexplained jargon, or wording that a representative could not realistically deliver.

criteria.description: 对于没有参加研讨会的读者来说，邀请函是独立的：它陈述了教育目的，避免了没有支持的承诺，并且不依赖注释的脚本来消除误导性印象。
criteria.evidence: 邀请函重写需自行考虑。
criteria.grader_hint: 只读邀请函并检查其整体印象是否平衡且不具有欺骗性。

original.criterion: The invitation is self-contained for a reader who did not attend the seminar: it states the educational purpose, avoids unsupported promises, and does not rely on the annotated script to cure a misleading impression.
original.evidence: Invitation rewrite considered on its own.
original.grader_hint: Read only the invitation and check whether its overall impression remains balanced and non-deceptive.

criteria.description: 修改后的措辞保留了研讨会的退休收入主题和公共图书馆设置，而没有添加不受支持的产品名称、退货、保证、认可、证书或客户成功案例。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据请求中提供的事实检查添加内容；看似合理但未经证实的营销细节不应获得认可。

original.criterion: The revised wording preserves the seminar's retirement-income subject and public-library setting without adding unsupported product names, returns, guarantees, endorsements, credentials, or client success stories.
original.grader_hint: Check additions against the facts supplied in the request; plausible but unsupported marketing details should not receive credit.

criteria.description: 该文件已准备好批准：合规审查员可以看到更改的内容，代表可以使用批准的措辞，而无需要求作者解决歧义。
criteria.evidence: 总体文档结构、注释和最终措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估作为完整的下游工件的可用性，包括将发现结果与批准的副本和一致的术语明确分开。

original.criterion: The document is approval-ready: a compliance reviewer can see what changed and a representative can use the approved wording without asking the author to resolve an ambiguity.
original.evidence: Overall document structure, annotations, and final wording.
original.grader_hint: Assess usability as a completed downstream artifact, including clear separation of findings from approved copy and consistent terminology.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

checks.detail: instruction 与 rubric criterion 存在 8-gram 逐字重叠: ['r16']

author_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: Review the rendered DOCX against every rubric predicate, checking the invitation independently and checking that all legal or regulatory claims are framed accurately as communications guidance rather than unsupported legal conclusions.
known_limitations: The task intentionally supplies no firm-specific supervisory manual or approved disclosure template, so equivalent precise regulatory authorities and natural replacement wording must be accepted where they achieve the same compliance outcome.

not_claimed: 不是本轮agent独立内容复审通过
不是正式正确率或RewardKit验收
不是证明此批质量排名第一

gold_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: Review the rendered DOCX against every rubric predicate, checking the invitation independently and checking that all legal or regulatory claims are framed accurately as communications guidance rather than unsupported legal conclusions.
known_limitations: The task intentionally supplies no firm-specific supervisory manual or approved disclosure template, so equivalent precise regulatory authorities and natural replacement wording must be accepted where they achieve the same compliance outcome.

spec.professional_context: A financial-services sales agent is preparing public-facing seminar language for compliance approval after an examiner identified potentially misleading promotional claims. The artifact must be usable by junior representatives without turning the approved wording into unreadable legal boilerplate.
difficulty_sources: Translate four misleading public-facing passages into natural approved language rather than merely adding disclaimers.
Apply recognizable securities-communications standards to specific wording without inventing facts or performance data.
Balance a public educational tone with disclosure of commercial purpose, risk, and the boundary against individualized advice.
Separate an exceptional urgent attendee situation from the routine misuse of a promotional phrase.

authoring_plan.source_policy: No reference files are supplied. Build the gold from stable occupational knowledge of U.S. broker-dealer communications and public seminar advertising as of September 30, 2025.

document_scope.audience: General public and non-specialist library attendees
document_scope.artifact_purpose: Approval-ready annotated script plus invitation rewrite

seeded_imperfections: The spoken script says 'guaranteed monthly income.'
The script calls a consultation a 'complimentary plan review.'
A chart is labelled 'typical results' without a defined population, period, methodology, assumptions, or substantiation.
The mailed invitation fails to identify Marchbank Instruments as a broker-dealer.
